zh-CN: 实验室新增拖拽转换：图片、PDF、音视频格式转换，ZIP / TAR.GZ 打包与批量解压。
支持先按住 Shift 再拖起文件；原件保留，进度、取消和最近 20 次记录集中在页面中。
拖拽菜单采用更清晰的灰阶配色，新增 WebP 转换并保留透明背景。
触发键默认为 Shift，可自定义为单个按键；自动保存设置，并提示输入监控权限和 AI / 框选按键冲突。
en: Add Drag Convert in Labs for images, PDFs, video and audio, ZIP / TAR.GZ packing and batch extraction.
Hold Shift before or during a file drag. Originals are kept; progress, cancellation and the last 20 batches stay on the page.
Improve drag-menu contrast with a grayscale palette; add WebP conversion with transparency.
Shift is the default trigger; customize it to one supported key. Settings are saved automatically, with Input Monitoring guidance and AI and selection shortcut conflict checks.
